---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible Codev problem without sharing private data or source
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
assignees: ""
---

## Affected release or development commit

State the Codev version and, when relevant, the development commit. Also state
the compatible local Elysia version. Do not paste a local bridge credential.

## Environment

Describe the operating system, VS Code-family host and version, workspace-trust
state, and Elysia Developer-profile state. Keep machine and account details to
the minimum needed to reproduce the problem.

## What happened

Describe the observed behavior and the expected behavior.

## Reproduction

List the smallest safe sequence that reproduces the problem. Use a disposable
repository and synthetic files where possible.

## Bounded diagnostics

Include only sanitized Codev/Elysia status, receipt identifiers, or error text.
Do not attach source snapshots, credentials, private logs, absolute local paths,
personal data, or confidential project content.

## Safety check

- [ ] This is not a vulnerability report. Use the private security contact in
      the issue chooser for security concerns.
- [ ] I removed credentials, source content, private data, and confidential
      information.
- [ ] I checked that the issue is not already reported.
